llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile data source is modeled as a Jotai async read atom with `atom(async () => ...)`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: profileAtom is defined with `atom(async () => ...)` — a Jotai async read-only atom.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile read atom fetches from the users endpoint
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The atom fetches from 'https://dummyjson.com/users/1', which is the users endpoint.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile content reads the async atom through `useAtomValue`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProfileCard reads the async atom via `useAtomValue(profileAtom)`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile consumer is rendered under `Suspense` with explicit loading fallback UI
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProfileCard is wrapped in `<Suspense fallback={<ActivityIndicator .../>}>` inside ProfileContent.
